appStore.name: JabLab: Shadow Training
appStore.subtitle: Solo martial arts practice
appStore.promotionalText: Original written beginner lessons in boxing, kickboxing, Muay Thai, karate and Tai Chi, with non-contact solo practice and your own self-checks.

playStore.shortDescription: Five solo martial arts courses; camera coaching is not open.

description:
JabLab offers original written beginner courses in five martial arts, for non-contact solo practice:

• Boxing: 39 lessons in 8 modules, from stance and guard to footwork, straight and curved punch shapes, planned defensive movements, combinations and your own shadowboxing rounds.
• Kickboxing: 16 lessons on stance, guard, steps, jab and cross, controlled front-kick preparation and simple punch-kick links.
• Muay Thai: 16 lessons on stance, guard, footwork, straight punches, teep, knee and elbow preparation and a paused practice sequence.
• Karate: 16 kihon lessons (stances, seiken, hikite, choku-zuki, gedan-barai) and 10 lessons on the beginner kata Taikyoku Shodan.
• Tai Chi: 14 fixed-foot foundation lessons and a written study of the Yang Family 16 form sequence.

Read the lessons, follow the practice tasks, check yourself and continue from your local lesson record. Lessons and interface are available in 14 languages. These courses do not teach sparring or contact training and do not claim readiness for it. No lesson completion certifies mastery. Demonstration video is not included.

Subscription: the first lessons of every course are free. JabLab ($11.99/month or $69.99/year) or Motion+ ($19.99/month or $129.99/year, all five Motion apps) opens the remaining lessons and the independent practice stage, with a 14-day free trial for new subscribers. Prices are shown in your local currency in the store. Payment is charged to your store account; the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed or cancelled in your store account settings.

You can browse without signing in and use an optional shared Motion account. The account uses your email address, account ID and optional display name; account deletion is available in the app. Course records stay on the device within the current guest or account scope.

You record practice and completion yourself. Camera coaching and automatic punch counting are not available. The courses do not measure impact force, punch speed, technique accuracy or personal safety.
$measurementDisclosureLine: MEASURED / WATCHED AND COACHED, NOT SCORED / WHAT WE DO NOT MEASURE ucluu, description alaninin kendi icinde — HonestyBox'in (Discipline.measured/notMeasured) magaza karsiligi. ⚠️ Ilk baslik J-212'de 'MEASURED AND GRADED' iken 'MEASURED' oldu: bugun hicbir sey puanlanmiyor, yani 'GRADED' desteksiz bir tier iddia ediyordu. store_listing_test ucluyu artik SATIR capasiyla zorluyor (eskisinden siki; mutasyonla dogrulandi: baslik govdeye gomulunce kapi otuyor).
$combinationClaimCorrection: KOORDINATOR CAPRAZ KONTROLU (2026-08-12) — J-162/163'u KESIN cozdu: 'Combination order and timing' MEASURED'dan NOT-MEASURE'a tasindi. Olcum: WRONG_HAND_FOR_COMBINATION ve COMBINATION_ORDER_ERROR ikisi de evaluateAt:['COMBINATION_END'] istiyor (boxing@1.0.0.json); COMBINATION_END motor kodunda (lib/ + packages/jablab_engine/) SIFIR yerde geciyor — grep pozitif kontrollu. condition alanlari sequenceMismatch'e bakiyor (striking_engine.dart _Ctx) ve bu alan TEK YERDE tanimli (deklarasyon), HICBIR YERDE ATANMIYOR. evaluateAt dispatch'i (striking_engine.dart:495) `e.evaluateAt.contains(marker)` — marker motorun GERCEK faz kimlikleri (GUARD_READY/EXTENSION/PEAK/RETRACTION/GUARD_RECOVERED), COMBINATION_END bunlarin hicbiri degil → bu iki hata KALICI ERISILEMEZ. J-162/163'un 'hala gecerli mi' sorusu artik KESIN cevaplandi: EVET, ve suphelenden DAHA KOTU (kismi zayiflik degil, tam-olu mekanizma). ⚠️ AYNI ASIRI-IDDIA `boxing.foundations.one_two` dersinin CANLI ogretme metninde de VARDI ('We watch the order and the timing between the two') — koordinator hukmu (2026-08-12): sevk edilmis yalan tasklaktan ONCE gelir, AYNI TURDA duzeltildi + supurme yapildi (uc hata kodu ulasilamaz cikti, ucuncusu TEMPO_TOO_FAST_FOR_FORM yeni bulundu, hicbir canli metin ona dayanmiyordu) + genel kapi kuruldu (packages/jablab_engine/test/error_reachability_test.dart).

cameraPermissionRationale.ios: Camera coaching is disabled in this release. If separately enabled in a later release, JabLab uses the camera for on-device movement feedback. Camera images and body positions are not uploaded or saved. Session history stays on this device.
cameraPermissionRationale.$source: ios/Runner/Info.plist NSCameraUsageDescription — BURAYA KOPYALANDI, DEGISTIRILMEDI. Tutarlilik: description'daki 'never leaves your device' cumlesiyle BIREBIR ayni iddia.
cameraPermissionRationale.$correctedWhy: J-211 (2026-08-12): onceki metin *'the app only keeps the body landmarks it measures'* diyordu ve OLCULDU — uygulama HICBIR landmark saklamiyor. Diske yazilan her sey: sessions.jsonl (lessonId, completedAt, workedSeconds, unitsCompleted, plannedUnits, unitLabel, lessonClass — vucut verisi YOK) + onboarding_seen (tek bayt) + poz modeli .task (paketten cikarilan asset). Landmark yalniz o KARE icin yasiyor (resolution.frame!.landmarks -> iskelet cizimi), tampon yok. Cumle gerceklesmeyen bir saklamayi iddia ediyordu. 'never uploaded' yarisi DOGRU: uretim Dart'inda (34 dosya) ag cagrisi 0, ag paketi importu 0 — sabotaj-dogrulamali tarama (HttpClient enjekte->1, geri al->0). NOT: bu cumlenin IKINCI bir yuzeyi vardi ve onu `store_listing_test`in plist-tutarlilik kapisi buldu — plist duzeltilince kapi otedi, yani yanlis cumle magaza listesine de girmisti.

rationale: Realistic or cartoon violence: NONE — solo shadow boxing, hicbir rakip TASVIR EDILMIYOR, dovus mekanigi yok
Contests / competitive play against others: NONE — cok-oyunculu ya da siralama yok
Medical/treatment information: NONE — CLAUDE.md kurali: tibbi dil yasak, uygulama wellness/antrenman dili kullaniyor, tani/tedavi iddiasi yok
Unrestricted web access: NONE — uygulama ici tarayici yok
User-generated content / sosyal paylasim: NONE — kamera goruntusu cihazdan hic cikmiyor (yukaridaki izin metni), yukleme/paylasim ozelligi yok
